prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — here’s how to get backflow testing and repair near Liberty, MO and how to pick a good provider.

Who does it
- Licensed plumbers who are certified backflow testers
- Irrigation/sprinkler companies (many test irrigation backflow assemblies)
- Water treatment companies and some fire protection contractors
- Larger national plumbing services with Kansas City branches

What to check for when choosing a provider
- Certification: tester must be a certified backflow tester recognized by your water utility or state (ask for tester ID/certification)
- License and insurance
- Experience with the type/size of your backflow preventer (residential irrigation vs. commercial assembly)
- They should provide a completed test report and, if required, will submit it to the City/utility
- Ask for a written estimate for repairs and parts

Where to look / who to contact locally
- City of Liberty Utilities (or your local water utility): they often maintain a list of approved/certified testers and can tell you reporting requirements
- Platte County or Missouri DNR cross-connection control pages for certification requirements and guidance
- Local search resources: Google Maps, Yelp, Angi/HomeAdvisor — search “backflow testing Liberty MO” or “backflow tester near Liberty MO”

Typical cost and timing
- Testing: commonly about $60–$150 per device (varies by region and device complexity)
- Repairs: depend on parts/labor; get an estimate before work
- Most tests take 15–45 minutes per device

- Look up and list specific certified testers and plumbers near Liberty, MO (phone numbers, hours, reviews) — tell me if you want that and confirm you want businesses in Liberty city limits or the broader Kansas City/Platte County area.
- Provide sample questions to ask a tester or a checklist for the test report.
